raw_text: This EA just showing a sample of Martingale Systems by Averaging Up or Averaging Down. It is not a ready to use or profitable EA. Default using TEMA Indicator as Entry Signals and ATR as Grid Steps for taking orders. Users can download and modify the source as needed. Regards. Update: - Fix Bug Errors on Trailing Functions. - Add function to Trail on Averaging Up. - Revised Indicator Codes.
